mapper.select:
WITH RECURSIVE dates AS ( SELECT CURDATE() - INTERVAL 104 DAY AS study_date
UNION ALL
SELECT study_date + INTERVAL 1 DAY FROM dates WHERE study_date < CURDATE() ),
daily_activity AS ( SELECT DATE(exam_at) AS study_date, COUNT(*) AS solved_count FROM member_quiz_history WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND answered = TRUE
AND exam_at >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 104 DAY AND exam_at < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY GROUP BY DATE(exam_at) )
SELECT dates.study_date AS date, CASE WHEN COALESCE(daily_activity.solved_count, 0) = 0 THEN 0 WHEN daily_activity.solved_count < 5 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS level FROM dates
LEFT JOIN daily_activity ON daily_activity.study_date = dates.study_date
ORDER BY dates.study_date
